scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。

papers.title: REDSI: Addressing the Reproducibility and Evaluation Consistency of Differentiable Search Indexing for Document Retrieval
papers.authors: Vivien Nicolas, Hicham Randrianarivo, Pascale Sébillot, Caio Corro
papers.abstract:
Abstract: The differentiable search index (DSI) framework (Tay et al., 2022) has become the de facto baseline for generative retrieval. However, DSI is hard to reproduce: no public implementation covers all three original document identifier types (atomic, naive, semantic), reported results vary widely, and the ubiquitous NQ320K dataset is built from Natural Questions through diverse and underspecified preprocessing. We introduce ReDSI, the first open-source DSI implementation supporting all three identifier types, together with a parameterizable and well-documented NQ320K construction pipeline.
 Experimentally, we achieve results that are competitive with or stronger than previous DSI baselines. Moreover, we conduct extensive experiments under model downscaling, covering retrieval effectiveness, parameter efficiency, training methods and decoding strategies, opening novel directions for future research.
papers.summary: 论文针对 DSI 基线难以复现、NQ320K 构造口径不统一的问题，发布覆盖原子、任意数字和语义三类标识符的 ReDSI，并拆分文档去重与文本序列化流程。在 Title/NciNorm 设置下，4400 万参数原子模型的 MRR@10 达到 62.2，超过 2.2 亿参数的任意数字标识符模型 60.1 和 Semantic ID 模型 59.7。
papers.key_insight: 社区 UGC 搜索试验应先固定帖子身份、去重规则和文本截断口径，再比较生成式召回模型；否则数据构造差异可能被误认为模型收益。原子标识符可作为中小语料试点的强基线，但每篇文档新增输出向量，其在千万级动态帖子库上的成本仍需实测，论文未提供线上 CTR 或 nDCG 收益。
papers.scoring_rationale: 直接服务 UGC 生成式检索基线建设；创新主要在可复现工程与受控比较，公开实现及多组消融支持实用性与证据评分。
papers.preference_rationale: 命中用户 generative retrieval 兴趣，主题加分 0.3；维度对齐不额外加分。

papers.title: Exploring Bottom-Up Clustering for Creating Semantic IDs
papers.authors: Leah Woldemariam, Sudhanshu Garg, Taha Belkhouja, Charles Kim-Yip, Ali Sahami
papers.abstract: Abstract: The success of generative retrieval has largely been attributed to the use of Semantic IDs, which improve over arbitrary item-level identifiers such as hashes by capturing the semantics of items. The main challenges faced when constructing Semantic IDs, however, is in mapping each identifier to a unique product and capturing information valuable to downstream tasks. Past works have appended additional codewords to de-duplicate item identifiers and utilized residual quantization to create hierarchical clusters. In this work, we present an algorithm for generating Semantic IDs that ensure the identifiers are both unique and preserve the structure of the original embedding. Key to our work is the use of bottom-up clustering to preserve local structure in the embedding space, improving the clustering quality of the resulting Semantic IDs and their utility for downstream generative retrieval.
papers.summary: 论文用自底向上聚类构造 Semantic ID：先保留商品向量的局部邻域，再逐层合并加权质心，并通过叶内编号保证唯一性。在约 600 万商品的自建数据上，Recall@10 从 0.020 增至 0.036；Beauty 的 NDCG@10 从 0.0255 增至 0.0296，但 Sports 的同一指标从 0.0169 降至 0.0166。
papers.key_insight: 可将该方法用于社区帖子 Semantic ID 的离线构建，重点验证近邻保持、碰撞率及新增帖子的编号稳定性。Sports 上的退化说明轮廓系数改善并不保证检索收益；应同时监控长尾覆盖与 nDCG，并把聚类分裂造成的 ID 迁移纳入更新成本评估，不能仅凭唯一性或单个数据集结果决定替换码本。
papers.scoring_rationale: 与 UGC 语义 ID 设计紧密相关但需迁移；方法为聚类工程改进，实验存在数据集退化且缺少线上验证，因此实用性与证据各记 3 分。
papers.preference_rationale: 命中用户 generative retrieval 兴趣，主题加分 0.3；维度对齐不额外加分。
